title: HyperFrames: HeyGen's Programmatic Video Framework
summary: An Apache 2.0 open-source framework for building high-quality videos using web technologies like HTML, CSS, and React. It is designed for high-performance rendering and optimized for programmatic control by AI agents.
research_notes: Positioned as a fully open-source alternative to Remotion with an Apache 2.0 license and first-class support for AI-native video generation workflows.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from an internal HeyGen tool to a major open-source ecosystem with over 12,000 stars. Recent updates introduced an 'Agentic Video Stack' and integration with AI coding assistants.
